usermeta.purpose: Visualizes annual rates of return (%) across Northern, Western, and Southern GRDC cropping zones from 2000 to 2024 relative to a 0% baseline.
usermeta.chartType: Diverging Grouped Bar Chart with Zero Reference Line
usermeta.dataRequirements: Requires 'Year', 'Region' (GRDC Zone), and 'Rate_of_return' fields in grains_state_yearly.csv.

title.text: Grain Industry Rate of Return Across GRDC Zones (2000–2024)
title.subtitle: Diverging annual rate of return (%) above and below 0% baseline

data._comment: Loads 25-year GRDC regional grains industry annual performance dataset

transform._comment: Step 1: Exclude incomplete records lacking valid GRDC zone or return values
Step 2: Aggregate mean rate of return per year and GRDC zone

layer.description: LAYER 1: Grouped bars for Northern, Western, and Southern GRDC zones extending above/below 0%
LAYER 2: Horizontal reference rule anchored at Y = 0 to visually separate positive profit from capital loss
